baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction joining the taking in word 1 to nakal in word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The taking is culpability-responsive seizure, while nakal makes the event a punishment whose preventive force addresses would-be repeaters as well as the person seized.

activation_trace.role: The accountability branch makes the taking answer a prior fault.
The exemplary-punishment branch gives the seizure an outward deterrent function.

changed_reading.before: God simply takes hold of him.
changed_reading.after: God seizes him for culpability in a way designed to deter conduct beyond this one offender.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The capture branch of the taking and the fetter branch of nakal.
baseline_models.mechanism: Capture transfers the target out of autonomous action, and nakal specifies the result as immobilizing restraint rather than undifferentiated pain.

activation_trace.role: The capture branch supplies a custodial loss of freedom.
The fetter branch makes prevention of further movement the capture's function.

changed_reading.before: The taking names an unspecified punitive event.
changed_reading.after: The taking is a capture that removes capacity to continue and holds the offender under restraint.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated and reverse-ordered pair of the latter and the first in words 4-5.
baseline_models.mechanism: The latter and the first function as endpoints. Naming the later endpoint before the first creates retrospective coverage, so one nakal answers a whole temporal or ordinal span rather than an isolated instant.

activation_trace.role: The after-first branch supplies the span's latter endpoint.
The beginning-and-precedence branch supplies the span's first endpoint.
The single exemplary punishment governs both coordinated endpoints.

changed_reading.before: The latter and the first are two opaque labels attached to the punishment.
changed_reading.after: Their reverse-ordered coordination makes the seizure retrospectively answer the full span from first to latter.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The delay branch of the latter term and the outcome-return branch available under the first term.
baseline_models.mechanism: The latter can mark a deferred time, while the first term can echo the outcome to which something returns. Together they permit an origin-to-consequence arc in which accountability eventually comes back upon its initiating act.

activation_trace.role: The postponement branch supplies a consequence held over to a later time.
The return-and-outcome branch lets the first act be read through what it comes to.
The accountability branch closes the inferred origin-to-consequence arc.

changed_reading.before: The two time terms merely locate two moments.
changed_reading.after: The seizure is the deferred outcome into which the initiating act finally returns.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context supplies an earlier refusal and a later explicit claim to supreme lordship. The latter-first pair can therefore retrospectively index an escalation from denial and disobedience to an articulated sovereignty claim.

activation_trace.role: The exemplary-punishment branch makes the whole escalation answerable.
The latter branch can point to the escalation's latest endpoint.
The first branch can point back to the initiating refusal.
Denial supplies the first explicit negative response in the narrated escalation.
Departure from obedience turns denial into enacted refusal.
Voiced speech makes the later offense an overt declaration.
The sovereignty branch identifies what the declaration arrogates.
The arrogant-height branch supplies the declaration's climactic excess.

structural_cues: Verses 79:21-24 form an ordered escalation immediately before the result-marking opening of 79:25.
The focus pair itself looks backward in latter-then-first order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial, disobedience, voiced sovereignty, arrogant height, and the latter-first branches; I assign the paired endpoints to the latest and earliest offenses. A live alternative is that the pair names this life and the afterlife rather than two narrated acts.

changed_reading.before: The seizure covers an unspecified temporal span.
changed_reading.after: The seizure answers a developing offense-history, from initial refusal to the later public claim of supreme lordship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The claimant of highest lordship is made the pronominal object of God's very next action. Capture and fettering thus enact a jurisdictional reversal: asserted sovereignty loses both agency and freedom under the divine subject.

activation_trace.role: The worship-and-deity branch marks the taking subject as the actual divine claimant.
The capture branch turns the prior speaker into a controlled object.
The fetter branch materially negates the claimant's capacity to rule.
The lordship branch states the sovereignty being claimed.
The domination branch sharpens the claim into asserted supremacy.

structural_cues: The first-person claimant in 79:24 becomes the attached object pronoun in 79:25.
The two clauses are adjacent and the second begins as a consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies claimed lordship and domination followed by divine capture and restraint; I read the grammatical agency reversal as a jurisdictional refutation. The live alternative is that the adjacency indicates punishment without specifically dramatizing transfer of sovereignty.

changed_reading.before: God captures and restrains an offender.
changed_reading.after: The capture itself refutes counterfeit lordship by converting its self-declared sovereign into God's restrained object.

context_deltas.mechanism: Nakal's other-directed deterrence is carried across persons by the following lesson, received through fearful heed, and extended by the surah's closing warning. The seizure is therefore a communicative event as well as retribution.

activation_trace.role: The exemplary branch builds an audience beyond the punished person into nakal itself.
The lesson branch transfers one person's condition into guidance for another.
Reverent fear supplies the receptive disposition on which deterrence works.
Warning carries fear-producing notice from the narrated case to later hearers.

structural_cues: Verse 79:26 immediately points to what precedes as a lesson for one who fears.
The final address in 79:45 defines the messenger's role by warning the one who fears the Hour.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deterrent punishment, transferable lesson, fear, and warning; I connect them as a communication chain from event to audience. The demonstrative in 79:26 may encompass the whole Moses-Pharaoh account, but that broader referent still contains the seizure.

changed_reading.before: The punishment terminates Pharaoh's own offense.
changed_reading.after: The punishment is also evidence engineered to restrain later hearers through lesson, fear, and warning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier resurrection dispute repeatedly images return to an initial state. Against that sequence, the latter-first pair can describe a loop in which the latter condition is a return upon the first, rather than merely two unrelated dates.

activation_trace.role: The latter branch supplies the post-first endpoint of the loop.
The beginning branch supplies the state to which the context imagines return.
The return branch introduces restoration to a prior condition.
The branch of going back to the beginning makes the return explicitly origin-facing.
Repetition after a first occurrence gives the return a second pass.

structural_cues: Verses 79:10-12 ask about being restored after bodily decay and call that restoration a losing return.
The focus phrase orders its endpoints from latter back to first, matching the direction of return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three return-to-origin images and the latter-first pair; I let the resurrection loop organize the pair. A live alternative is that the pair concerns two offenses or two punishment domains without encoding return itself.

changed_reading.before: The latter and first are points on a one-way line.
changed_reading.after: The latter is a returned condition that folds back upon the first, and the seizure spans that denied return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later context places a person's acquired action into memory and then exposure. This gives the focus pair a causal reading: an initiating deed persists into a delayed, disclosed outcome where accountability takes hold.

activation_trace.role: The accountability branch makes the seizure answer remembered action.
The delay branch supplies temporal distance between action and consequence.
The outcome-return branch lets the endpoint disclose what the first act came to.
The work-and-acquisition branch supplies the originating deed.
Recovered memory carries the deed forward rather than letting it disappear.
Disclosure makes the delayed consequence perceptible at the endpoint.

structural_cues: Verses 79:35-36 place remembered striving and manifest consequence together on a later day.
The focus verse already couples a later term with a first term under one act of taking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acquired action, memory, exposure, delay, and outcome-return; I add the causal arrow that the exposed endpoint is the deed's matured consequence. The alternative is a simpler chronology with no lexical play on outcome under the first term.

changed_reading.before: The focus names punishments at two times.
changed_reading.after: It can image one accountability arc in which an initial deed survives, is disclosed later, and returns as its own punitive outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah contrasts overstepping with a person who checks the inner self against inclination. Nakal as a preventing fetter becomes the externally imposed counterpart of the internal restraint the transgressor failed to exercise.

activation_trace.role: The fetter branch supplies an external check that prevents further movement.
Overstepping a limit supplies the unchecked movement that requires restraint.
The self-checking branch supplies voluntary prevention as the positive counterpart.
The inner faculty branch locates the voluntary check within the person.
Inclination supplies the motion that the inner check must arrest.

structural_cues: Verses 79:37-41 form an explicit two-case antithesis between overstepping and self-restraint.
The earlier Pharaoh episode uses the same overstepping predicate before the focus seizure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies overstepping, inner inclination, voluntary checking, and nakal's preventing fetter; I infer a compensatory relation in which failed self-restraint is answered by imposed restraint. The alternative is that the two passages only classify different destinies without making restraint the shared mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Nakal is punishment imposed from outside.
changed_reading.after: Nakal is the imposed restraint that mirrors and replaces the self-restraint the overstepper refused to perform.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later contrast identifies a choice that privileges the lower or nearer life. That preference makes the focus's latter-first span evaluative: the first or near domain is selected over the later one, yet the single nakal binds consequences across both.

activation_trace.role: The latter branch supplies the domain displaced by preference for what is near.
The first branch supplies the earlier endpoint provisionally aligned with the near life.
The preference branch turns temporal placement into a deliberate ranking.
The lower-near-world branch specifies which side of the ranking is favored.

structural_cues: Verse 79:37 repeats the overstepping predicate from the Pharaoh episode before describing preference for the near life.
The two destinies in 79:39-41 follow directly from that preference contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preference for the lower-near life and the focus's latter-first pair; I align the first endpoint with the near life and read the pair as a value conflict. The live alternative is that the first term refers to an earlier offense, not worldly life.

changed_reading.before: The latter-first pair is a neutral chronology.
changed_reading.after: It exposes a failed preference calculus: the near or first life is chosen over the latter, but accountability spans both.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human claim to arrogant height is followed by the seizure and then by the actual sky's construction and elevation. Capture under that larger architecture becomes a demotion of counterfeit height, not only a penalty for a verbal offense.

activation_trace.role: Capture relocates the claimant from imagined supremacy into subjection.
Restraint fixes the claimant below the order he tried to exceed.
Arrogant elevation supplies the false vertical claim.
The sky branch supplies the actual encompassing height used for comparison.
Construction by joined parts makes height the result of ordered agency, not self-assertion.
Actual raising answers the claimant's merely spoken elevation.

structural_cues: The highest-lord claim, divine seizure, and question about the sky occur consecutively in 79:24-27.
The sky's elevation is predicated as an accomplished act rather than a self-description.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arrogant height, capture, sky, construction, and raising; I compare the claimed and constructed heights and read seizure as demotion. The alternative is that the creation passage argues only for resurrection power and does not comment back on the claim's spatial rhetoric.

changed_reading.before: The seizure punishes an arrogant sentence.
changed_reading.after: It spatially corrects counterfeit height by placing the claimant under the genuinely raised and ordered creation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence supplies extraction, rapid pulling, forward precedence, and management toward an outcome. Read as a process grammar rather than a participant identification, it turns the focus capture and fetter into the terminal arrest of a managed transfer.

activation_trace.role: Capture supplies the point at which the transferred target comes under control.
The fetter branch converts the movement sequence into a terminal stop.
Removal from an established place supplies the sequence's departure.
Rapid pulling supplies acceleration after extraction.
Forward precedence gives the motion a directed ordering.
Management with regard to outcome supplies governance over the sequence.

structural_cues: Verses 79:1-5 present an ordered participial series, reinforced by repeated verbal nouns and forward-linking conjunctions.
The focus likewise begins with a result-linking conjunction before the capture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered motion lexicon and the focus supplies capture plus restraint; I transfer the sequence's process shape to the seizure without asserting common agents. The live alternative is that the opening series is independent and contributes no process model to Pharaoh's taking.

changed_reading.before: The taking is a punctual blow detached from the surah's movement language.
changed_reading.after: The taking can be heard as the controlled endpoint of removal and transfer, where managed motion terminates in restraint.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers a water-control image into a human seizure. It remains anchored because the focus inventory explicitly offers a water-holding taking and a preventing fetter, while Pharaoh's context root offers overflow. Downstream prose should render it only as a material analogy for containing transgression, not as a translation or a claim that this verse narrates literal drowning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The water-holding branch of the taking combined with the preventing branch of nakal.

activation_trace.role: A receptacle that holds water supplies the material image of containment.
The fetter branch converts containment into prevention of further advance.
Overflowing water supplies the material analogue for boundary-breaking transgression.

changed_reading.after: As a contained material echo, God's taking holds an overflow inside a restraint so it can advance no farther.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the immediate form of the focus's final word denotes the first, while the packet's split mapping also exposes branches of authority under the mapped WLY root. It remains valid as a secondary echo because capture follows a claim of lordship and domination. Downstream prose should preserve the normal temporal force and qualify confiscated authority as wordplay activated by the split mapping, never as a replacement lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The final focus occurrence's non-dominant mapped branch of undertaking authority, heard beneath the capture construction.

activation_trace.role: Capture supplies the confiscating action.
The authority-and-governance branch supplies the deliberately form-distant echo of office.
Claimed lordship identifies the office the echo would place at stake.
Claimed domination sharpens the authority that capture removes.

changed_reading.before: The final word only closes a temporal pair.
changed_reading.after: At a contained secondary level, the seizure also confiscates the claimed authority encoded by the immediately preceding lordship boast.

strongest_changes: Nakal became a transferable warning mechanism linking punishment, lesson, fear, and warning rather than a private penalty only.
The immediate subject-object reversal turned capture into an enacted refutation of claimed supreme lordship.
The preventing-fetter branch made imposed punishment the mirror image of the self-restraint later required against inclination.
Return, memory, and disclosure kept multiple temporal readings live: two offenses, first life and latter return, and an originating deed maturing into delayed outcome.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package made the focus verse function at once as custody, public sign, temporal hinge, moral restraint, and scale correction. Its strongest latent activations came from sequences and reversals, not from broad topic matching.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact referents of the latter and the first remain open among two narrated offenses, two life domains, and an origin-outcome arc.
The opening motion sequence may supply only a formal process analogy rather than a shared event or participant.
The hydraulic and WLY activations are intentionally branch-distant and should remain qualified echoes.
